## OPEN — the findings the wraps must close
- UNFIRED jubilee_proclaimed (watched by law_slave_term): watched by law_slave_term (the era-wide release); the skeleton's scene 5 reaches the jubilee through slave_pierced's jubilee_year TIMER instead — the seeding's finding; W5's yovel wrap fires it from Lev 25:10
- UNCONSUMED overflow_reported: submitted by cold_run_sanctuary_build.py at Exod 36:5 (the craftsmen's report); law_sanctuary_build comments 'no law' — the halt (36:6) is the act that writes; kept on the tape as the recorded report
- ALIAS milluim_blood_sprinkled: garments_sprinkled (cold_run_incense_shekel.py law_investiture) is the SAME act at the same verse under a second name — one verse, two daemons, two kinds; to be unified at the wrap
- ALIAS milluim_leftover: meal (cold_run_incense_shekel.py law_investiture: Lev 8:31-32 -> burn_remainder) covers the same command under a second name; to be unified at the wrap
- ALIAS hands_feet_washed: DECLARED AT THE SEEDING, NOT YET SUBMITTED: cold_run_erection.py submits this act under the kind name 'washed' — the same name cold_run_incense_shekel.py uses for the BODY washing of Lev 8:6 — and its daemon writes hands_feet_sanctified on it; the two acts are two types (immersion against the laver's sanctification), so the erection's kind is to be renamed to this id at the wrap
- ALIAS renamed: consumed by TWO daemons (law_family with a `name` field, law_pre_sinai without one) writing the same effect — one type, one field contract to be fixed at the wrap
- ALIAS washed: cold_run_erection.py submits the laver's hands-and-feet washing (Exod 40:31) under this same kind name — see hands_feet_washed
- ALIAS garments_sprinkled: the same act as milluim_blood_sprinkled (world_engine.py law_installation) at the same verse — one verse, two daemons, two kinds; to be unified at the wrap
- ALIAS meal: the leftover clause it carries (8:32) is milluim_leftover's under law_installation — to be unified at the wrap
- ALIAS overflow_reported: submitted on the construction tape and consumed by NO daemon (the harvest's one orphan — the daemon comments 'no law')
- ALIAS jubilee_proclaimed: CONSUMED BY law_slave_term BUT NEVER SUBMITTED ON ANY TAPE: the skeleton's scene 5 reaches the jubilee through slave_pierced's jubilee_year TIMER instead — a watched branch no tape has fired (the daemon-edge gate's coverage column will show it)
